Bill.BriefDescription: Providing guidelines for the issuance and renewal of a geoduck diver license and requiring harvesters to help reseed state commercial beds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to geoduck harvesting; amending RCW 77.65.410; anddeclaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.65.410 and 1993 c 340 s 24 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Licensed geoduck harvesters bear the responsibility forproviding the labor and equipment to plant geoduck seed provided by astate hatchery onto state commercial beds. (2) Every diver engaged in the commercial harvest of geoduck clamsshall obtain a nontransferable geoduck diver license. (3) After July 1, 2006, the director may not issue new geoduckdiver licenses. A person may renew an existing license only if theperson held a geoduck diver license in 2004, and: (a) Held a geoduck diver license for a minimum of five of the tenyears from 1994 through 2003; or (b) Acquired the license by transfer from another person who heldit during the previous year, and the person did not subsequentlytransfer the license to a third party. p. 1 HB 3102 (4) The director must revoke a geoduck diver license issued afterJanuary 1, 2006, that does not meet the criteria of subsections (1)through (3) of this section. (5) Geoduck diver licenses are not transferable. The licenseholder must perform the actual harvesting. (6) The director must revoke geoduck diver licenses that are notrenewed by December 31st of each year.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
